nodes.label: Caratulas Proveedor capability (caratulas-proveedor)
nodes.rationale: Caratula file lifecycle as a first-class concern: per-account storage, upload/preview, staging entry, diff message, migration of legacy 1:1 caratulas; owns its own storage naming and file handling.

nodes.label: Caratula count badge + Ver caratulas modal
nodes.rationale: Row badge counts accounts with a caratula (zero → no badge); badge click opens the preview modal; 'Ver caratulas' action lists one entry per caratula with preview reusing the fullscreen viewer; legacy single thumbnail render path removed.
